name: Nazyvaevsk District Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (Loris-Melikovo-Spassk-Kochkovatka)

values.RouteNotes: No public GIS or map of the line found; settlements served (Loris-Melikovo, Bogodukhovka, Cheremnovka, Kochkovatka, Spassk, Fomikha, Kochkovatsky siding) are named in the refs only. Start/end are the extreme named settlements, not sourced pipeline termini.

researcher_notes: Not inside P3982 (Tyukalinsk-Valuevskaya-Nalimovskaya-Nazyvaevsk, 98 km, Gazprom trunk-spur serving Valuevskaya/Nalimovskaya/Nazyvaevsk GRS): this is a separate 49.6 km inter-settlement network in Nazyvaevsk district for Loris-Melikovo, Bogodukhovka, Cheremnovka, Kochkovatka, Spassk, Fomikha and Kochkovatsky siding, fed from the Nazyvaevsk-area GRS, announced by Gazprom Mezhregiongaz 27 Apr 2021 (49.6 km, ~5 km laid, completion planned Q4 2021) under the Omsk 2021-2025 gasification program. Commissioned 20 Jun 2025 (governor Khotsenko; 521 households, 6 boilers), built by Oblgaz jointly with Gazprom. Length 49.6 km is stated identically at announcement and commissioning by independent outlets (neftegaz/Gazprom release, Omsk Gazeta, GTRK Irtysh, Prigorod55), though the 2025 coverage says 'new gas networks' and separately 35.4 km of intra-settlement networks, so 49.6 is the inter-settlement pipe. A regional-program search snippet showed a planned 52.8 km for this line (docs.cntd.ru decree 187, not verifiable, timed out). Owner = Gazprom PJSC by analogy with P3982 and 'jointly with Gazprom' wording; operator/owner of the asset after commissioning (Gazprom gazoraspredelenie vs Oblgaz) not confirmed, medium confidence on Owner. Distribution-class pipe; GEM tracks comparable rows (P3982). Operating line never captured, >=25 km, sourced length: passes threshold. Endpoints are extreme named settlements, not sourced termini. Tier high for existence/status/length.
